# .github/audit-allowlist.txt -- Patch SX-09.
#
# The ONLY dependency-audit findings the CI job `dependency-audit` may let through.
# .github/scripts/check_audit.py compares the pip-audit and npm audit reports with
# this file and fails the job for anything that is not listed here.
#
# Format (one entry per line; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored):
#
#     ID | scope | reason | expires=YYYY-MM-DD
#
#   ID       any id the audit tool reports for the finding: GHSA-..., PYSEC-...,
#            CVE-... (pip-audit lists the aliases of a finding too; npm audit
#            gives GHSA ids). Case does not matter.
#   scope    python    (backend/requirements.txt, read by pip-audit)
#            frontend  (frontend/package-lock.json, production packages)
#            promptfoo (backend/evals/promptfoo/package-lock.json, production packages)
#   reason   plain words: why it is allowed and what removes it (a patch name or
#            a decision). The reason cannot contain the "|" character.
#   expires  the last day the entry is valid. From the next day the job fails
#            until someone fixes the dependency or renews the entry on purpose.
#
# The job also fails when an entry matches no current finding (stale), so a fixed
# dependency forces its line to be deleted in the same change.
#
# Filled by patch SX-10 from the live audit of 2026-11-23 (pip-audit 2.10.1, npm audit). One line per
# finding, grouped below by the patch (or decision) that removes it. Lines that say "fixed by SX-nn"
# expire 2027-01-07 (45 days); lines that say "accepted" expire 2027-02-21 (90 days at most). A patch that
# fixes a group deletes exactly that group's lines; the job fails on a line whose finding is gone.
